title: A Model-Driven Automation Pipeline for Building Operation
abstract: arXiv:2611.21631v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Building Control Systems (BCS) engineering in the Architecture, Engineering, Construction & Operations (AECO) domain remains a complex, manual, and error-prone process, with fractured tools and manual commissioning causing design and built reality to diverge into a performance gap. We argue that a fully integrated and automated, tool-supported workflow spanning design, programming, and operation is feasible and can improve efficiency while reducing manual effort and configuration errors. Building on model-driven engineering, we present an automated process pipeline for modeling, programming, and auto-commissioning BCS. It uses two domain-specific modeling languages with tooling support to synthesize and deploy executable artifacts from platform-independent models, replacing a fractured, multi-stakeholder handoff process with a defined four-step workflow and improving consistency across the engineering lifecycle. translated_title: 面向建筑运营的模型驱动自动化流水线
translated_abstract: 在建筑、工程、施工与运营（AECO）领域，楼宇控制系统的工程化过程仍然复杂、依赖人工且容易出错，工具割裂和手动调试导致设计与建成现实之间出现偏差，形成性能差距。我们认为，一个覆盖设计、编程和运营环节的完全集成、自动化且由工具支持的工作流是可行的，它能够在减少人工投入和配置错误的同时提升效率。基于模型驱动工程，我们提出了一个用于楼宇控制系统建模、编程和自动调试的自动化流程流水线。该流水线使用两种支持工具的领域特定建模语言，从平台无关模型中综合并部署可执行制品，以定义明确的四步工作流取代割裂的多方交接过程，从而提高工程全生命周期内的一致性。我们的评估报告显示……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于模型驱动工程的楼宇控制系统自动化流水线，利用两种领域特定建模语言从平台无关模型自动生成并部署可执行制品，将设计、编程与自动调试整合为四步工作流，以减少人工投入和配置错误。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a model-driven automation pipeline for building control systems that uses two domain-specific modeling languages to synthesize and deploy executable artifacts from platform-independent models, unifying design, programming, and auto-commissioning into a four-step workflow to reduce manual effort and configuration errors.
